features.text: Includes two 10° heel wedges secured to the frame of the boot to provide gradual Achilles tendon stretching.
Available with a Plus liner featuring a pneumatic quick pump for customized compression or a basic breathable foam bootie for lightweight comfort.
Provides support and stability for a wide range of ankle and foot conditions.
Promotes proper foot positioning and reduces strain on the Achilles tendon.
